name: Oliver Slater
title: Cloud Architect
bio:
Cloud Architect specialising in the design and delivery of enterprise-scale cloud solutions, with deep expertise in AWS, platform engineering, and large-scale cloud transformation programmes. Proven track record of defining cloud strategy, leading cross-functional teams, and establishing architectural standards that enable secure, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms across regulated and high-availability environments. Combines strong technical depth with the ability to influence stakeholders, drive governance, and align technology solutions to business outcomes.

AWS Golden Jacket holder and AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional with 11 AWS certifications, possessing advanced expertise in Infrastructure as Code (using Terraform, CloudFormation and AWS CDK), serverless and event-driven architectures, and cloud-native design patterns. Additionally certified as a Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-104, AZ-305), providing cross-cloud capability to support multi-cloud and hybrid strategies. Experienced in leading migrations, modernisation initiatives, and DevOps transformations, with a focus on engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
coreCompetencies: AWS Golden Jacket Holder & 11x AWS Certified
Enterprise Cloud Architecture & Multi-Cloud Strategy (AWS & Azure)
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK)
Serverless & Event-Driven Systems (DynamoDB, Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS)
Large-Scale Cloud Migrations (AWS MGN, DMS, Well-Architected Framework)
DevSecOps, Platform Engineering & CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Security Hub)
